name: CEO Office
purpose: Sets direction, strategy and assurance for ACE; owns the OMS commitment and leadership expectations.

name: Exploration & Development
purpose: Finds, appraises and develops gas resources; owns the subsurface description, reservoir management and reserves.

name: Wells
purpose: Designs, drills, completes, intervenes on and abandons wells safely; owns well integrity across the well life cycle.

name: Engineering & Projects
purpose: Delivers capital projects and owns engineering standards and technical integrity through the discipline leads and the Technical Leadership Council.

name: Operations
purpose: Operates and maintains the Gulf of Paria platforms, the land leases and the Central Processing Facility; owns day-to-day control of work and asset integrity execution.

name: HSE & Compliance
purpose: Sets HSE and process safety requirements, provides specialist support, manages emergency response and security, and assures OMS conformance.

name: Finance
purpose: Manages financial planning, accounting, tax, treasury and joint-venture partner reporting.

name: Human Resources
purpose: Recruits, develops and retains staff; owns organisation design, competence assurance and industrial relations.

name: Supply Chain Management
purpose: Procures goods and services, manages contracts and contractors, and runs marine, aviation and materials logistics.

name: IT, Data & Knowledge
purpose: Provides IT and OT infrastructure, data platforms, cyber security and the controlled document and knowledge system.

name: Business Development & Markets
purpose: Sells ACE gas to the Gas Buyer and markets crude, manages partner relationships and develops new venture opportunities.

name: Communications & Corporate Services
purpose: Manages internal and external communications, community relations, offices and corporate services.

name: Legal & Government Affairs
purpose: Provides legal advice, corporate secretarial services and manages licences and relations with government and regulators.
